title: Ambullee sinni ankacsa
intro: yanbullee baadak reebeynak darrel, qeltut tan kobox ditet gaaboowak, oson yaaxigeenih yaniinim inkih saduh tan xongolot hirgimte. oson numma miracsenta sinnim mango dabaanitteh weseenih sugen, ilaa xongolo ken ambullee wayta nummah tibbat culteeh, addat kak tanim uguugussa. Ta bar, silal fanah gexak, ta sirri buttah kinnaane diggoysoonuh, diini qangor luk sugeenim, sinni ummattah gabat gacteh tan nummah warkat keenih akah culsan innah arcibisen.
clues: Nanu dumaahi gino kinnino, mango agattiinaani atu takriyeek naharal sugne, uxih nanu sahdayti baxi aydaadittet yabneh nan.
Ni gino ku gino hinna, ambulle waytaamak bicsen liyyitteh addat, kee nanu qaadik tan caylitte lino.
dabaanah, nanu numma miracsenta sinnim meekitak sugne, ilaa xongolo nee guftam fan too tukteenay addat kak uguugussa.
Nanu naabbem hinna innah tan kiryaati noobbeh, faxe yaabuk qilsa quukak tan qangor.
Nanu sirrit xayyowneh, ninnih tibba innam amrisneeh, ayat gaba kalte wak, nanu uxih sugnam madudna.
Nanu ninni ummatta fanah gacneeh, diggosnem: Yaa ni ummatta, nanu noobbeh kitab muusah lakal oobeeh, tohuk naharal sugtem diggossah, numma fan miraacissa.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Illa abaaro elle sugnem fiyaamah ayro fanah.

Nanu ninni miraacak xaqut baddal culneh sugne.
outcome.answer: Nanu ninni ummatta fan naduurem takkaawisso, imaan maysaxxaga

arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
verse: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone. (72:2)
